== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3872]] is assessed at 81% (probable). James’s held 1883 Belfast marriage account identifies father William, whereas his 1933 Illinois death names James and mother Mary Bones. The selected profile represents this unresolved parental identity, so fatherhood is supported but a combined William James name and 1881 Belfast death remain unproved.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Compare original 1883 marriage and 1933 certificate, including occupations and informants.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-3871 Son's death record.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


The GRONI index lists a James Glasgow–Hughes marriage on 31 August 1870 in the Belfast district; its connection to this profile remains open.<ref>[https://geni.nidirect.gov.uk/search/marriage GRONI civil marriage index], 31 August 1870, Belfast district, M/1870/B1/2330/4/77.</ref>
